t: What Artificial Womb / Ectogenesis Chambers Is
title: What Artificial Womb / Ectogenesis Chambers Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Artificial wombs are fluid-filled bio-bags supporting premature infants outside the body: replicating the uterine environment — oxygenation, nutrition, waste removal — letting extremely premature babies develop as if still in the womb. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Artificial Womb / Ectogenesis Chambers: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Artificial Womb / Ectogenesis Chambers in one line: Artificial wombs are fluid-filled bio-bags supporting premature infants outside the body: replicating the uterine environment — oxygenation, nutrition, waste removal — letting extremely premature babies develop as if still in the womb.
Why it matters: Extreme prematurity kills and disables; artificial wombs let babies finish developing..
Where it is used: extreme prematurity, neonatal rescue..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Artificial Womb / Ectogenesis Chambers
